The affine group of order 78 gives three exact orbits 26,39,39. Over Q the d2 and d3 ranks are precisely 66 and 130, bounded above by rank d1=12 and mod-two rank d4=65, respectively. A 66-by-66 determinant -1 shows integral surjectivity onto the edge-cycle lattice; two separate 155-by-155 determinants -1, each built using 130 genuine d3 columns and 25 spheres from one 39-orbit, give complete integral bases of ker d2. Exact rank d3=130 implies its image is saturated and the quotient is free Z^25. All certificates are reconstructed and checked by bundled verifier.

value.rationale: For a canonical strongly regular six-regular graph, the exact minimum-support and inclusion-image problem is a natural invariant not recoverable from the known ambient Betti number. All 104 shortest induced spheres are classified, and strikingly either of two distinct 39-element symmetry orbits alone integrally spans 25 global classes, while the remaining 26-element orbit fails modulo two. The integral saturation is not a routine field-rank corollary and supplies a reusable explicit lattice generating description.
